::: {#exr-ce-logit-grad}

#### The gradient at the logits

Find the derivative of the [cross-entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cross-entropy) loss $L = -\log \operatorname{softmax}(\vz)_y$
with respect to each [logit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits) $z_m$, for $m = 1, \dots, C$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint
Start from [the log softmax theorem](feedforward-networks.qmd#thm-log-softmax).
:::
